parser.description: Linux service templates and lifecycle inspection for the Zeus aibox host.

render.fleet_unit:
# zeus-aibox-fleet: the ONE systemd owner of `zeus fleet run` on aibox (SPEC-retirement-update s9).
# Rendered by `zeus_aibox_service.py render`; every placeholder is replaced with an explicit value.
# Installing, enabling or starting this unit is an owner action outside this template.
[Unit]
Description=Zeus aibox Fleet runner (single owner)
Documentation=file:///srv/zeus/deploy/aibox/README.md
PartOf=zeus-aibox.target
After=network-online.target docker.service
Wants=network-online.target docker.service
# Bounded restart: at most 3 starts in 10 minutes, then the unit stays failed for a human.
StartLimitIntervalSec=600
StartLimitBurst=3

[Service]
# A non-template unit: systemd itself refuses a second concurrent instance of this owner.
Type=exec
User=zeus
Group=zeus
# Docker group membership is stated, not inherited from a login shell.
SupplementaryGroups=docker
WorkingDirectory=/srv/zeus/runtime/control
# Non-interactive environment: no login init, no ~/.profile, no inherited PATH.
Environment=PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
Environment=HOME=/home/zeus
Environment=LANG=C.UTF-8
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
Environment=ZEUS_AIBOX_ROOT=/srv/zeus
Environment=HARNESS_RUNTIME_DIR=/srv/zeus/runtime/control
# Non-secret host settings, then the service-UID-only secret file (mode 0600, outside Git).
EnvironmentFile=/srv/zeus/config/zeus-aibox.env
EnvironmentFile=/srv/zeus/secrets/zeus-aibox.env
UMask=0027
# The lifecycle journal the Fleet relocation proof reads (runner_state): start before, exit after.
ExecStartPre=/usr/bin/python3 /srv/zeus/deploy/aibox/zeus_aibox_service.py journal start --role fleet --journal /srv/zeus/runtime/control/fleet-service-journal.jsonl
# The launcher re-checks the fence and activation receipt, then execs the pinned release.
# It never resumes admission: a restored Fleet stays paused until the owner resumes it.
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /srv/zeus/deploy/aibox/zeus_aibox_service.py launch --role fleet
ExecStopPost=/usr/bin/python3 /srv/zeus/deploy/aibox/zeus_aibox_service.py journal exit --role fleet --journal /srv/zeus/runtime/control/fleet-service-journal.jsonl
# Stop: SIGTERM asks FleetRunner.stop() (admission closes, owned children drain). After the
# bounded wait every process left in THIS unit's control group gets SIGKILL. Docker containers are
# children of dockerd, not of this cgroup, and are NOT ended by it (see README "Docker residue").
KillMode=control-group
KillSignal=SIGTERM
SendSIGKILL=yes
TimeoutStartSec=60
TimeoutStopSec=180
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=15
# 78 (EX_CONFIG) is the launcher's fail-closed refusal: fenced, unactivated or unpinned.
RestartPreventExitStatus=78
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=full
LimitNOFILE=65536

[Install]
WantedBy=zeus-aibox.target
